<thought>We need the SMILES of the unknown sample. The mass spectrum shows a monoisotopic peak at m/z 127.0997 with an M+1 peak (~8 % intensity) suggesting ~7–8 carbons. The formula is likely around C6‑C8 with heteroatoms (O, N). To narrow down the structure, we should obtain the 13C NMR spectrum, which will reveal the number of distinct carbon environments and help infer the molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>Awaiting further data (e.g., 13C NMR) to determine the SMILES.</final_answer>
